title: Council Charter
description: Schema for a Hub or Spoke governance council charter.

council.description: Name of the council, e.g. 'Central Hub' or 'Procurement Spoke'.

domain.description: For spoke councils: the business domain this council governs. Omit for hub.

mandate.description: Primary mandate of this council, in plain language.

operational_scope.description: What this council has operational authority over.

veto_rights.description: Conditions under which this council can veto a proposal.

decision_rights.description: Decisions this council can make unilaterally within its scope.

applies_to.description: Which decision types this voting rule governs.

escalation_path.description: Name of the council/role this escalates to when unresolved.

sla_days.description: Maximum days to resolve an escalated arbitration.
